answer: Splitting into 7 separate vaults requires a separate funded zenith account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The oasis explorer shows the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the harbor binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 65 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
